name: RBP Approval Workflow
description: Orchestrates RBP permission change approvals. Flow 1: Receives an RBP recommendation from the AI agent, creates a SAP Task Center approval task for the HR Administrator or Compliance Officer, and — on approval — automatically applies the permission change in SAP SuccessFactors via the RBP Permissions MCP server. Flow 2: Generates quarterly RBP compliance reports covering SoD conflicts, change history, and best practice deviations.
